metadata.title: Community Guidelines - NailsZone
metadata.description: Rules and expectations for participating in the NailsZone community.

introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: Welcome to the NailsZone community! Our platform is dedicated to all things nail care, offering a space for enthusiasts, professionals, and novices alike to share, learn, and connect. These Community Guidelines are designed to ensure a positive and respectful environment for all members. By participating in the NailsZone community, you agree to these guidelines.

respectful_interaction.title: Respectful Interaction
respectful_interaction.courtesy: Courtesy and Respect: Treat all members with respect, kindness, and patience. Respect people’s boundaries and consent.
respectful_interaction.no_harassment: No Harassment or Bullying: Harassing, bullying, or threatening other users is strictly prohibited. This includes any form of intimidation, aggression, or coercion.

content_standards.title: Content Standards
content_standards.relevant: Relevant and Constructive Content: Please ensure your contributions are relevant to the topic at hand and aim to add value to the discussion.
content_standards.no_hate: No Hate Speech or Discrimination: Content that promotes hate or discrimination against individuals or groups based on race, ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic is not tolerated.
content_standards.safe_legal: Safe and Legal Content: Do not post content that is obscene, sexually explicit, illegal, or that promotes unsafe practices.

intellectual_property.title: Intellectual Property Rights
intellectual_property.description: Respect Copyrights and Trademarks: Only share content that you have the right to share. Do not post content that infringes on the intellectual property rights of others. Credit Original Creators: When sharing someone else’s work or content, make sure to give proper credit.

privacy_and_confidentiality.title: Privacy and Confidentiality
privacy_and_confidentiality.description: Personal Information: Do not share personal information about others without their explicit consent. This includes private conversations, contact information, and any sensitive personal data. No Impersonation: Impersonating other users, public figures, or NailsZone representatives is not allowed.

engagement_and_interaction.title: Engagement and Interaction
engagement_and_interaction.positive: Positive Engagement: Encourage positive interactions, share knowledge, and help others when possible.
engagement_and_interaction.reporting: Reporting Violations: If you encounter content or behavior that violates these guidelines, please report it to our team for review.

enforcement_and_consequences.title: Enforcement and Consequences
enforcement_and_consequences.description: Failure to adhere to these Community Guidelines may result in content removal, temporary bans, or permanent account termination, depending on the severity of the violation.

amendments.title: Amendments to Guidelines
amendments.description: NailsZone reserves the right to modify these Community Guidelines at any time to ensure the continued safety and integrity of our community. Changes will be communicated to the community appropriately.

contact_us.title: Contact Us
contact_us.description: For questions about these Community Guidelines or any of our policies, please contact us at <email>teamnz@levincigroup.com</email>.
